text:
Anja (PM): Quick async milecheck — small compact update for the milestone lane. I list shipped / slipped / next actions. Please ping owners and short clarifications only.

Mike L: Shipped: route-fallback v1 (handles GPU shortage -> falls back to cheaper model). Deployed to canary yesterday. :shipit:

Sophia (Eng): Slipped: runtime-v2 canary perf fixes. Found KV cache edge case causing jitter under 16-token warmups. Working on patch, PR #4123. ETA EOD Thu.

Lucas (Infra): Dependency note — autoscale policy for Dedicated still awaiting quota increase from cloud. Request submitted, waiting approval from accounts. Blocking burst testing.

Ravi (SRE): Can we roll canary back if we see p99 latency > 220ms? I can add alert with a temporary tweak.

Mike L: Yes — fallback policy already has an automated throttle. If p99>220ms deploy-bot will flag and revert canary routing to stable.

deploy-bot: Canary health check report: 2023-06-17T14:12Z — p50: 42ms, p95: 120ms, p99: 210ms, errors: 0.2%.

Anja (PM): Sophia — if PR slips past Thu, how much does that shift the milestone? Do we still hit the release window?

Sophia (Eng): If patch not in by Thu EOD we lose two engineering days for validation; practical ship moves ~1 week. I'll prioritize tests and ask QA for an expedited pass tomorrow.

Lucas (Infra): For autoscale quota: ask accounts to escalate to partner rep. I can run a manual burn test in staging if quota doesn't land by Fri — won't be production-accurate but enough for perf signoff.

Ravi (SRE): QA note — when you push patch, include these commands in PR description so I can replay traces fast:
```
# collect traces for failing keys
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"input":"warmup test"}' https://canary.api.redwood/v1/generate
```

Mike L: Heads-up: small UX tweak from design landed that touches the routing config UI. Not blocking runtime; moving to follow-up sprint. :+1:

Anja (PM): Next steps:
- Sophia: prioritize PR #4123, tag @Ravi when pushed (owner).
- Lucas: escalate quota with accounts, or confirm manual staging burn test by Fri.
- Mike: track UX follow-up as post-milestone task.
- All: update this thread with 1-line status by EOD.

Sophia (Eng): Will do — pushing a green branch by tomorrow morning.

Lucas (Infra): Escalated to partner rep, awaiting reply. If no answer by 16:00 PT Thu I'll run the staging burn and post results.

Ravi (SRE): I'll add the temporary alert and a runbook note for rollback.

Mike L: Marking shipped items in the milestone doc.

Anja (PM): Thanks — short check-ins only after this, please. If anything unexpected, ping in #eng-oncall. :eyes:
